title: Design System: Home Hub
tonalRampNote: Every tonalRamp is a derived, illustrative OKLCH ramp synthesized around the canonical value for the sidecar preview. Only the canonical values are shipped tokens (src/index.css); ramp steps are not tokens.

display.purpose: Kiosk headline metrics only (text-display, bold, tabular-nums).

headline.purpose: Page titles and kiosk widget titles at container width @xl (Fraunces, tracking -0.01em).

title.purpose: CardTitle and section headings; 18px is the Fraunces floor.

body.purpose: Figtree for all controls, lists and tables; tabular-nums utility on numerals (Figtree has tnum, Fraunces does not).

label.purpose: Secondary and meta text at 12px, Figtree.

shadows.name: elevation-card
shadows.purpose: Light-theme card lift (shadow-card). Dark theme: none.

shadows.name: elevation-overlay
shadows.purpose: Light-theme popovers and dialogs (shadow-overlay). Dark theme: none.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Global :focus-visible in the base layer; ui primitives repeat it.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Clay call-to-action, 36px tall, 44px on coarse pointers.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--primary, oklch(0.53 0.13 45)); color: var(--primary-foreground, oklch(0.985 0.01 85)); height: 36px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9.6px; font: 500 14px/1.5 'Figtree Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary, oklch(0.53 0.13 45)) 80%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, oklch(0.53 0.13 45)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } @media (pointer: coarse) { .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; } }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet sand fill for secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: var(--secondary, oklch(0.93 0.025 75)); color: var(--secondary-foreground, oklch(0.28 0.025 55)); height: 36px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9.6px; font: 500 14px/1.5 'Figtree Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--secondary, oklch(0.93 0.025 75)) 80%, transparent); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, oklch(0.53 0.13 45)); outline-offset: 2px; } @media (pointer: coarse) { .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 44px; } }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Transparent field with the darker 3:1 control border.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 32px; width: 220px; padding: 0 10px; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.24 0.02 55)); border: 1px solid var(--input, oklch(0.62 0.02 65)); border-radius: 9.6px; font: 14px 'Figtree Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.47 0.025 60)); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, oklch(0.53 0.13 45)); outline-offset: 2px; } @media (pointer: coarse) { .ds-input { min-height: 44px; font-size: 16px; } }

components.name: Widget Card
components.description: Kiosk widget: container-query card with a Fraunces title and tabular metric.
components.css: .ds-card { container-type: inline-size; background: var(--card, oklch(0.995 0.004 85)); color: var(--card-foreground, oklch(0.24 0.02 55)); border-radius: 15px; padding: 16px; box-shadow: var(--elevation-card, 0 1px 2px oklch(0.3 0.03 50 / 0.06)), 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground, oklch(0.24 0.02 55)) 10%, transparent); transition: background 120ms; } .ds-card:hover { background: var(--accent, oklch(0.93 0.035 145)); } .ds-card-title { margin: 0 0 8px; font: 500 18px/1.5 'Fraunces Variable', Georgia, serif; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-card-metric { font: 700 28px/1.2 'Figtree Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } @container (min-width: 36rem) { .ds-card-title { font-size: 28px; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-card-metric { font-size: 48px; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-card { transition: none; } }

components.name: Status Banner
components.description: Inline status with icon and text; warning uses warning-text for the icon.
components.html:
!
Weather data is out of date.
components.css: .ds-banner { display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: flex-start; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--warning, oklch(0.80 0.13 80)); border-radius: 12px; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--warning, oklch(0.80 0.13 80)) 10%, transparent); color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.24 0.02 55)); font: 14px/1.5 'Figtree Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-banner-icon { color: var(--warning-text, oklch(0.50 0.11 70)); font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Swatch Chip
components.description: Tracker colour: solid dot beside a soft tint, via swatchClass(color, role).
components.css: .ds-swatch { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--swatch-teal-soft, oklch(0.93 0.04 183)); color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.24 0.02 55)); font: 500 12px/1.5 'Figtree Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-swatch-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--swatch-teal, oklch(0.62 0.096 183)); }

narrative.overview:
Warm paper, clay and herb green, set in a soft old-style serif for headings and a friendly geometric sans for everything that is read or tapped. The system is comfortable rather than dense, calm rather than busy, and both themes are first-class: light is cream paper, dark is warm brown-black, never blue-black or neon.

One component set serves three contexts: a phone in one hand (coarse-pointer targets), a desktop planning session, and a wall kiosk read from 2-3 m (container-query type steps inside widgets). Content is the household's own data; nothing decorative fills space.
keyCharacteristics: OKLCH tokens in src/index.css, one set for :root and one for .dark; components use token utilities only.
Hue family: clay (45), herb green (145), ochre (80), warm neutrals (55-85).
Two typefaces, self-hosted, no runtime third-party requests.
Status is never colour alone: icon plus text.
Light mode lifts surfaces with soft warm shadows; dark mode uses no shadows.

rules.name: The Warning-Text Rule
rules.body: --warning is an ochre fill and fails as text on light surfaces. Warning-coloured text and icons use --warning-text. Use --warning for fills and borders only.

rules.name: The Single Action Colour Rule
rules.body: Clay (--primary) is the only call-to-action colour and the focus ring. Herb green (--accent) is a quiet wash for hover, selection and active nav, never a button fill.

rules.name: The Swatch Module Rule
rules.body: Components never spell a swatch class. They call swatchClass(color, role) from src/lib/constants/swatches.ts with roles solid, soft, border.

rules.name: The Neutral Fallback Rule
rules.body: An unknown or empty colour string resolves to the muted neutral fallback; a swatch never renders as undefined.

rules.name: The Token-Only Rule
rules.body: no-color-literals.test.ts fails on any hex, rgb/hsl/oklch literal or Tailwind palette class in components/features and pages.

rules.name: The 18px Serif Floor Rule
rules.body: Fraunces is used only at 18px (text-lg) or larger, and never for controls, labels, table cells or body copy.

rules.name: The Tabular Numerals Rule
rules.body: Figtree has tnum; Fraunces does not. Numerals use the tabular-nums utility per element in Figtree; there is no numeric fallback font.

rules.name: The Tonal Dark Rule
rules.body: Never add a box-shadow in dark mode; use the surface lightness step and the hairline ring.

dos: Do use token utilities (bg-primary, text-muted-foreground, bg-swatch-* via swatchClass) for all colour.
Do put focus on every interactive element as a 2 px --ring outline, offset 2 px; the base layer provides it.
Do honour reduced motion; the base layer collapses animation and transition durations globally.
Do convey status with an icon plus text, with colour as reinforcement only.
Do keep touch targets at least 24 px and add coarse:min-h-11 / coarse:size-11 to any new control.
Do use Fraunces only at text-lg or larger and add tabular-nums to numerals.
Do build widgets as @container cards with @xl: steps and WidgetError for failures.
donts: Don't write palette classes, hex, rgb(), hsl() or oklch() literals in components/features or pages.
Don't use --warning as text colour; use --warning-text.
Don't put calendar user colours into tokens, or hard-code ink/paper on them; compute with eventChipColors.
Don't add shadows in dark mode.
Don't use viewport breakpoints for widget internals; use container queries.
Don't invent placeholder copy, stats or testimonials; only household data fills the UI.
